tasks.title: SchemaProvisioner trait in fdb-ports
tasks.detail: Per FFS-001 §7 sketch + plan-store methods (persist_planned/load_planned) per plan D-P1. async_trait, thiserror, #[non_exhaustive] error enum, # Errors docs. Sits beside SchemaProvider (introspects) — this one mutates.

tasks.title: PgProvisioner with own pool from PROVISIONER_DATABASE_URL
tasks.detail: New module in fdb-postgres. Own deadpool config; connection role must be/SET ROLE flint_provisioner. Absent env var => constructor returns config error (feature is off; gateway won't build it when allowlist empty).

tasks.title: Explicit transaction discipline (D7)
tasks.detail: BEGIN -> statements -> COMMIT on the SAME connection; ROLLBACK on first error. Do NOT route through DatabaseBackend::acquire (conn.rs BEGIN-for-lifetime discards uncommitted writes on recycle).

tasks.title: Ledger writes with applied_by attribution
tasks.detail: planned (upsert by plan_hash) -> applied|failed. applied_by: &str param (JWT sub from gateway), applied_at now(), version_before/after from flint_meta schema version, error_code = SQLSTATE only. Partial unique index makes double-apply a conflict -> alreadyApplied signal.

tasks.title: Error mapping: SQLSTATE only
tasks.detail: Map tokio-postgres errors to the port error carrying e.code() (SQLSTATE); NEVER the rendered statement (may embed operator identifiers) and never bind values.

tasks.title: Tracing span at port boundary
tasks.detail: span fields: plan_id, namespace, role. Nothing else — no claims, no tenant ids, no bearer (constraints BLOCK).

tasks.title: Integration tests written (run at boundary)
tasks.detail: crates/fdb-postgres/tests/ DATABASE_URL-gated: (a) D7 — apply then open a FRESH connection and SELECT from the new table; (b) failed mid-plan statement -> no partial table, ledger failed row with SQLSTATE; (c) flint_provisioner cannot CREATE outside granted namespaces (insufficient_privilege).
